title: Canadian Brisket Sandwich
description: A hearty, slow-cooked brisket served on a bun with a tangy BBQ sauce.
instructions: Season the brisket with salt, pepper, and your favorite spices.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the brisket until browned on both sides.
Transfer the brisket to the oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the brisket from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the brisket against the grain into thin strips.
Heat the BBQ sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced brisket to the BBQ sauce and toss to coat.
Split the buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the sandwiches by placing the brisket mixture onto the buns.
Top with cheese, if using, and serve immediately.
